editorial.blurb: Jōtō Sushi at CH Distillery serves some of Chicago's finest sushi in a sleek, modern setting that feels like a hidden gem within the distillery itself.
editorial.insiderTip: Request seating in the front dining area when you arrive—reviewers rave about its vibrant, high-end atmosphere compared to the back room, and don't hesitate to ask even if the restaurant appears quiet.
